caption: The drawing shows a bronze or copper-toned statue of a man dressed in a Western-style outfit. He stands on a round, decorated pedestal with geometric patterns around the edge. The man wears a wide-brimmed, high-crowned hat with indented sides, a long-sleeved shirt with a neckerchief, a vest or coat draped over his left arm, suspenders, pants, and boots. His right hand holds a pair of eyeglasses or spectacles with thin wire frames. The facial features include a mustache and a beard, and there is a five-pointed sheriff’s badge on his left chest. The statue has an overall brownish-green patina, with shadows and highlights indicating a metallic surface. The background is a plain, off-white color with some faint spots and discoloration. At the bottom right of the pedestal, there is a written name: "AL. FARCONE."
title: Plaster Cast Figurine
